source: Every stay and the bar week are paid. Each payment is completed, so the same amount is a revenue entry. referenceId stays null until the stay or bar order is saved, then set it from the matching ref.
assumptions: Stay payments equal the stay total. Status is completed.
Stay messages have no M-PESA or bank receipt, so provider is manual and method is null.
OCT-O-1016A and OCT-O-1016B are two payments that came from one KES 16,000 Ochieng message.

The bar payment is the full sales total, KES 20,500, status completed. KES 12,100 of that cash was the Stanbic deposit (receipt UJIKGA3056 at 1:23 pm). KES 8,400 was spent on stock and is in expenses.json.
